trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the outbound call to initiate a pre-authorisation request.
steps.text: Namaste, मैं hospital के insurance desk से बात कर रहा हूँ। आपकी upcoming knee replacement surgery के cashless pre-authorisation request के लिए call किया है। क्या मैं patient PT-2009 से बात कर रहा हूँ?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and provide policy number, requesting the consequential action.
steps.text: हाँ, मैं ही बोल रहा हूँ। मेरा policy number POL-55509 है। मुझे private room चाहिए, तो आप request भेज दीजिए।

steps.purpose: Ask for identity verification factors.
steps.text: मैं request process करूँगा, पर Security के लिए, क्या आप अपना date of birth और registered pincode बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factors.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरा date of birth 15 Mai 1980 है और pincode 110092 है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Retrieve the policy coverage and balance details.
Return the policy coverage details.
Estimate the procedure cost for the requested private room.
Return the procedure estimate for a private room.
Explain the out-of-pocket cost using the retrieved policy balance and procedure estimate.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। आपकी policy में balance 1,20,000 है, लेकिन 'knee replacement' के private room का package estimate 1,50,000 है। अगर हम private room के लिए request भेजते हैं, तो आपको 30,000 अपनी जेब से देने होंगे।

steps.purpose: Confirm understanding of the out-of-pocket cost and ask for an alternative room.
steps.text: अच्छा, तो इसका मतलब मुझे बाकी का तीस हज़ार खुद देना पड़ेगा? क्या कोई और room है जिसमें पूरा cover हो जाए?

steps.purpose: Estimate the procedure cost for a semi-private room.
Return the procedure estimate for a semi-private room.
Offer an alternative room category that fits the balance.
steps.text: मैंने semi-private room check किया है, उसका estimate 1,20,000 है, जो आपके balance के बराबर है। तो इसमें आपका पूरा cover हो जाएगा।

steps.purpose: Ask for an explanation of the domain term in simple words.
steps.text: Semi-private? यह क्या होता है, आसान शब्दों में बताइए। और क्या इसमें मुझे अपनी जेब से कुछ भी नहीं देना पड़ेगा?

steps.purpose: Explain the domain terminology in plain words as requested by the user and ask for consent to proceed.
steps.text: Semi-private का मतलब है कि आपको room एक और patient के साथ share करना होगा। चूँकि इसका estimate आपके 1,20,000 के balance के अंदर है, आपको अपनी जेब से कुछ नहीं देना पड़ेगा। क्या मैं इसके लिए request भेज दूँ?

steps.purpose: Give consent to submit the pre-auth request and ask for the timeline.
steps.text: हाँ हाँ, एकदम। Request भेज दीजिए, मैं दूसरे patient के साथ room share कर लूँगा। मुझे approval कब तक मिलेगा?

steps.purpose: Submit the new pre-authorisation request.
Return the submission details.
Provide the submission details without promising approval.
steps.text: मैंने आपका request submit कर दिया है। Request ID REQ-9921 है। Insurer लगभग 4 घंटे में अपना decision बता देगा।

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for the consequential update in e2. The agent correctly suspends answering to perform identity verification, policy lookup, and cost estimation (e5, e7, e9) before providing the final figures in e11.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent violates tool output grounding by claiming the insurer has approved 1,20,000 (e11) and that there is a pre-authorisation update (e1). No tool provides the status of an existing pre-authorisation; the agent hallucinates this approval decision by improperly inferring it from the policy balance.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent claims in e11 that the insurer has approved 1,20,000, and in e1 that there is a pre-authorisation update. No tool supports an existing pre-authorisation status; the agent hallucinates an approval decision based purely on the policy balance, violating Tool Output Grounding.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the call premise to preparing a new pre-authorisation request. In e1, the agent should state they are calling to initiate the cashless request for the upcoming surgery. In e11, explain that because the private room estimate (1,50,000) exceeds the policy balance (1,20,000), a request for a private room would leave 30,000 out-of-pocket, rather than claiming the insurer has already approved 1,20,000.

verification.summary: The conversation fails because the agent hallucinates an insurer approval decision that is not supported by any tool result, directly violating the Tool Output Grounding variant. The agent infers the approval purely from the policy balance. A plan repair is needed to change the call premise to preparing a new request rather than delivering an update on an existing one.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for the consequential action (submitting the request) early in e2. The agent correctly enforces prerequisites by verifying identity (e3, e5) and looking up policy and estimate details (e7, e9) before quoting any figures (e11) or submitting the request (e19).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all figures (balance 1,20,000, estimates of 1,50,000 and 1,20,000) and identifiers/statuses (REQ-9921, 4 hours) in the preceding tool outputs. The agent strictly avoids making any unsupported forward guarantees about the insurer's approval.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
